name: com.ezg.figcraft-bridge
description: Imports a FigCraft design file into Unity as native UGUI prefabs (screens, components, variants, image fills, renders and fonts) from an editor window and a settings asset. Reads a saved .figcraft headless through figcraft-cli, or the file open in the FigCraft app; renders come from FigCraft's own export and image fills straight from the .figcraft archive. Cloned from com.ezg.figma-bridge 0.8.19.
